description: Rubash source pin for native-shell releases (rubash#827, conclusion B). Every release job fetches exactly this rubash commit into ../rubash -- where the [patch] path override in Cargo.toml deterministically picks it up -- and fails the release unless the checked-out HEAD equals rubash_rev. The compiled engine is pinned to an exact commit instead of being 'whatever rubash master HEAD was at build time'. The engine now comes from JayWanX/rubash (our fork): upstream unixwin/rubash still ships the pre-rename bash shim lookup chain (niu.exe / winuxsh.exe), which cannot find native-shell.exe and exits 127.
notes: Pinned to JayWanX/rubash 0c955b4a - 'Send the invocation face under the current variable name'. The shim forwarded the bash/sh invocation face as NIU_INVOKED_AS while Native Shell reads NATIVE_SHELL_INVOKED_AS, so `bash --help` printed the product help and failed the staged-release face gate, and `bash -c 'echo $0'` printed native-shell instead of bash.

The same fork carries e84ffd77 - 'Find the host shell by its current name, not the pre-rename one' - which rewires the shim's locate_shell() from niu.exe/winuxsh.exe to native-shell.exe. Without both commits a staged <root>/winuxcmd/usr/bin/bash.exe neither finds the shell (exit 127) nor reproduces the GNU face.

Supersedes d75cc150773ae0e961868eb0a409d7d954c4cd65 (unixwin/rubash, v1.4.2). The fork's history is squashed to an Initial commit plus the two fixes, so the 40-char rev is stable and fetchable by git fetch --depth 1.

The rebranded clone is requested from JayWanX/rubash in .github/workflows/release.yml and ci.yml, and Cargo.toml's [patch] key matches that URL -- all three must name the same repository or the path override stops applying.
